privacy.overviewText: Privacy and GDPR compliance are core tenets of Pulse. We do not use third-party tracking, analytics cookies, or external font CDNs. Hosting and database (SQLite) run on Contabo GmbH servers in Germany (DPA under Art. 28 GDPR); standard server log files (IP address, browser, timestamp) are processed under Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.
privacy.participantText: Joining a live session requires no user account or registration. Responses, wordcloud contributions, and live emojis are transmitted via WebSockets and stored ephemerally with the session. Local Storage is used solely for functional flags (language preference, duplicate-vote protection), not for tracking cookies.
privacy.hostText: Host accounts store only the username and bcrypt-hashed password (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). Authentication uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) in Local Storage. Sessions and responses can be deleted by the host at any time.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), and restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (e.g. LDI NRW). For inquiries, contact daniel.notthoff@gmail.com.
